1. (Currently amended) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data is not transmitted as a transitory signal but is stored on the mobile device.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a Short Message Service (SMS) message containing a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control Short Message Service (SMS) message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information, wherein the control SMS message includes instructions to store the downloaded barcode image persistently on the mobile device.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein establishing a communications link with a mobile device comprises: sending a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data; and receiving, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data, wherein the SMS is Short Message Service.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC enabled mobile device, wherein NFC is Near Field Communication.

13. (Currently amended) A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data is stored persistently on the mobile device and is not transmitted as a transitory signal.

14. (Original)

15. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code that is persistently stored on the mobile device.

16. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code that is used to authenticate and redeem the coupon at a point of sale.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a Short Message Service (SMS) message containing a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode, wherein the barcode is downloaded and stored on the mobile device.

19.
